$comment: MCP server configuration for analyst access to Recall's memory.
Point an MCP client (Claude Desktop, Claude Code, or any other) at this
and it can query the corpus, the decisions and the actions — including
AS OF SYSTEM TIME, so an analyst can ask what an agent knew at the time
rather than only what is true now.
It connects as recall_reader, NOT recall_admin. That is the point: an
analyst tool with write access could alter the history it is meant to be
reporting on, and an LLM driving that tool makes the distinction sharper
rather than softer. create_reader.py --verify proves the boundary: every
Set COCKROACH_READER_URL in your environment first — the same value the
deployed app uses. It is never committed.
